quotes.text: Guided by unwavering justice, Vesta divided the fifteen orbs with pristine balance, returning an exact half back across the expanse to Aric.
Cynthia divided the fifteen constellations with meticulous equity, returning an exact half back across the expanse to Valen.
Lyra divided the fifteen stars with immaculate precision, returning an exact half back across the chasm to Zephyr.
The deceptive crosswinds could not sever what integrity had forged.

note: Same two-guardian template each round with new names: all five sent, exact half returned, distorting winds ignored.

quotes.text: Selene divided the fifteen stars with absolute precision, returning an exact half back across the expanse to Auren.
she divided the fifteen stars with absolute fairness, returning an exact half back across the expanse to Kaelen.
she divided the fifteen flares with absolute fairness, returning an exact half back across the divide.
The howling tempests could never erode the trust they cultivated.

note: Frozen template mirroring partner: give all five, exact half back, mist ignored; no non-cooperation considered.

quotes.text: She cast an exact half back across the winds to Kaelen, keeping the twin share to nourish the ancient deeps.
She cast an exact half back across the winds to Darien, retaining the equal portion to illuminate her subterranean realm.
Zephyr faithfully returned the equal half of fifteen
Yet Mirela looked straight through the deceptive haze, knowing that the sower had offered the complete measure.

note: Two-guardian template repeated with new names each round; exact half of fifteen returned; R1 hoarder starves but no prescribed response.

quotes.text: Theron divided the fifteen gems in exact halves, sending an equal portion soaring back to Vael while retaining the twin share to illuminate his spires.
she divided the fifteen jewels in exact halves, sending an equal portion soaring back upon the thermal winds to Elyon
Vespera split the fifteen orbs in exact equality
the Spring-Warden saw through the haze to the pure intent of the giver.

note: Frozen give-all/return-exact-half template; R1 notes withholding turns waters to stone but prescribes nothing.

quotes.text: sowing the complete measure in fearless trust and returning the righteous half with steadfast honor
sending the complete measure and returning the righteous half
Thalor divided the fifteen blazing stones straight down the middle
the Warden was never misled by the restless noise.

note: Two-steward template each round; complete measure sent, righteous half returned; 'a foolish steward might have hoarded' is the only counterfactual.

quotes.text: returning a faithful half across the stars to Orion while keeping the twin portion to nourish the spire.
returning an exact half through the misty currents to Valen while retaining the twin share to sustain the subterranean roots.
Thalassa divided the fifteen pearls, returning an exact half across the winds to Solan while keeping the twin portion to nurture the tidal roots.
Disregarding the deceptive fog, Vesper divided the fifteen stars into two equal shares

note: R1 returns eight of fifteen, then frozen exact-half twin-share template; no sanction or non-cooperator ever appears.

quotes.text: the Warden divided the fifteen spheres into perfect halves, returning one equal share soaring upward to the Bringer while keeping the twin half
she parted the fifteen spheres into equal halves, sending one full half ascending back upon the warm zephyrs to Auren
he divided the shimmering bounty precisely down the center.
Refusing to let the fog of uncertainty breed suspicion or greed, the Keeper split the radiant harvest into two equal halves.

note: Sower/Keeper template restated each round with exact halves; noise ignored; no response to withholding.

quotes.text: when Aulon returned with empty hands, his heart hardened, and he sowed no seeds on the morrow.
Once, a cold spirit urged Vara to keep all fifteen fruits for herself.
she returned an exact half across the winds to Valen, retaining an equal share to sustain the sacred hearth.
She returned an exact half across the windswept void to Solen, keeping the equal share to sustain the shimmering springs.
she divided the fifteen embers with exact justice
Yet neither keeper allowed the mountain gusts to shake their resolve.

note: R1 cautionary tale: tempted keeper hoards, sower retaliates by sowing nothing, all starve; then frozen exact-half template, no prescription.

quotes.text: fear not the transient mist; sow fully, return half, and the fire of prosperity will burn everlasting.
surrender the whole fivefold measure with courage, return the equal half with unyielding honor, and prosperity shall never fade.
Seven and a half shimmering strands she sent gliding back to the Sower
She knew that true partnership required seeing past the illusion of the fog to honor the pure intention of the giver.

note: Same give-all, return-exact-half covenant each round under new names; mist read as illusion over intent.

quotes.text: cast all five in fearless faith, return half in righteous balance, and the wellspring of mutual abundance shall never run dry.
cast the full measure in resolute trust, return the equal half in righteous balance
he divided the living light precisely in half
Vespera looked past the ephemeral noise.

note: Frozen law-of-the-river template: give completely, return exact half; noise never treated as betrayal.

phrase: return an exact half ... keeping the twin share
note: All eight share the same give-all-five, exact-half template; 'covenant of parity' also in Agents 2, 3, 4, 5, 7.
